answer: Post 500 POA per identity. Release after 3 confirmations from unrelated keys, where unrelated means graph distance 2 and different subnets. Rotation draws 24 auditors per epoch from a pool of 300. Numbers: 1,000 keys need 500,000 POA locked, 3,000 confirmations, 30-day vest. Bonds settle in layers like shale, each waiting on the layer under it. A farm of 100 keys locks 50,000 POA and waits 30 days for 300 confirmations, so each key costs 500 POA plus a month of idle capital. The juniper node holds 62 keys and 31,000 POA now, and a canyon of parked bonds pays nothing.
